secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase project API key (Firebase Console → Project Settings → General → Web API Key)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN
secrets.description: Firebase auth domain, e.g. <project>.firebaseapp.com (Firebase Console → Project Settings → General)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Firebase project ID (Firebase Console → Project Settings → General)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET
secrets.description: Firebase storage bucket, e.g. <project>.appspot.com (Firebase Console → Project Settings → General)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID
secrets.description: Firebase messaging sender ID (Firebase Console → Project Settings → Cloud Messaging)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_ID
secrets.description: Firebase app ID (Firebase Console → Project Settings → General → Web App)

secrets.name: FIREBASE_ADMIN_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase Admin service account JSON (Firebase Console → Project Settings → Service Accounts → Generate New Private Key). Paste the full JSON object.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe publishable key (Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API Keys → Publishable Key)

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key (Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API Keys → Secret Key)

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks → endpoint signing secret)

secrets.name: EMAIL_USER
secrets.description: Email address used by nodemailer for sending emails (e.g. notifications, payslips)

secrets.name: EMAIL_PASS
secrets.description: Email app password for the EMAIL_USER account (nodemailer SMTP)
